_notes.1: rev2: boxes 3+4 are one sentence in JP order; box 4 continues it lowercase (no restarted subject). Box-3 line break = the source 7530 between runs 4 and 5; the only added break is inside run 6.
_notes.4: rev2: 'each other' takes a period; the sentence continues across the 7532 — run 2 is box-1 line 2 and box 2 resumes lowercase with run 3. The only added break is the one after run 1.
_notes.5: m2: one sentence spanning all 4 boxes (lowercase continuations). 753B red span on run 6 ('sorcerer', JP 魔術使い). 1 added break inside run 2 so box 2's wrap is clean.
_notes.8: m2 rev2 (user feedback): box 3 ends 'me,' (red); box 4 = 'there was no one in this world / who could save him.' — no repeated 'this Beast Tamer'. 2 added breaks, both trailing: run 4 (box-3 line break) and run 7 (box-4 line break).
_notes.9: m2 rev3 (user wording): 'the Beast Tamer' (no 'this' before a person); closing line 'people took to calling him.' — title names the tamer, beasts share the legend but not the title. 1 added break inside run 0 (box-1 line break).
_notes.10: m3: caption ('~Mount Famfantar~', 7533) shows alone and then the box clears — verified in-game (story_run frames 10400-10700), sim splits there. Red spans kept on runs 2 (男/man) and 4 (火口/crater). 1 added break inside run 5 so line 2 reads 'which still belched smoke.' (no dangling-modifier seam).
_notes.11: m3: red on run 1 (イグニス). Added breaks inside runs 0 and 3 to split the two 2-line boxes; screen 2 = one JP line but needs the break in EN (full address kept: 'Ignis of the Earth').
_notes.12: m3: screens 3+4 are one sentence — screen 3 ends with the object ('take'), screen 4 lands the verb ('take revenge!!'; JP closes with ！！ and never closes the quote, so EN leaves it open too). 'on him... no, on this world.' mirrors the JP ヤツに、いやこの世界に pivot. Screen 2 keeps the full relative clause; EN needs 3 lines = 2 pages (JP: 2 lines).
_notes.13: m3: 7537 0000 prefix and both styled-dot spans (runs 1 and 5) kept. 1 added break inside run 7 — JP auto-wraps the same single 33-glyph segment at 17.
_notes.14: m3: caption (7533) like msg 10. No added breaks: the two source 7530s are the line breaks. Both pursuit lines mirror msg 15/16 card style.
_notes.15: m3: screen 1 = 3 segments -> box pages 2+1 lines (verified in-game, story_run frames 13800-14000; box clears and continues). Screen 2 mirrors label-alone + styled dots + 7534 pause. 'the name' keeps it neutral (gender unrevealed; player enters the name right after).
_notes.16: m3: three 7540 name inserts; red on the first name (runs 2-3 split) and on run 7 (ベリンガム様). Screen 3's quote stays open into screen 4 (JP closes only after たんまりと). 1 added break in run 12 ('... just then!' = JP cliffhanger その時！). 'Catch you for Lord Beringham' keeps 捕まえて on line 1.
_notes.17: m4: both breaks are the source 7530s. "the guards" = 追っ手達 (established msg 15: royal guards of Barroa).
_notes.18: m4: 7540 name insert (before run 1) + 7532 screen split; no added breaks. "in shock" = 唖然.
_notes.19: m4: 7535/7536 style span passes through; screen 2 breaks at the source 7530. あっというまに = "in no time".
_notes.20: m4: 7537(0002) and 7534(0006) pass through (invisible in-game, frames 18000). Speaker card "Old man:" — name arrives next message. やかましい → "Noisy!" (18 chars keeps row <=26).
_notes.21: m4: caption (7533) shows alone and clears. Added 1 break inside the quote run (JP auto-wraps mid-word). 753F(0001) prints the canned word ご子息 — DROP the control at insertion; EN carries "son" just before that position. Interpretation flag: line 1 read as "[reason] I heard the name Beringham" (milestone-04 flag 1).
_notes.22: m4: 7538(0031,0030) + 7540 pass through; the source 7530 is the row break. Red span = "yesterday's incident" (JP red = 事件 only; width compromise — milestone-04 flag 5). Runs carry a leading space in run 1 (after the name insert).
_notes.23: m4: 7531 clears the caption after the player's input (▼ verified, frame 19700). "Barroa's Vandam Castle" compresses バルロア王国、ヴァンダム城 to fit the 30-char row (milestone-04 flag 3).
_notes.24: m4: 7537(0032) passes through. JP clears the box between its two lines (2 display pages, frames 19900-20100); EN is also 2 pages but splits mid-sentence (milestone-04 flag 4). Added 1 break in run 2; 二世 = "II".
